verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs over the empty cream circle, so 'Blood' is white-on-cream and hard to read. The bottle has drifted out of its circle to sit beside the headline, and the NEW badge is jammed on top of the Try It button, so the result looks broken. B keeps the original structure, with the bottle in its circle, the headline, and the CTA on the right edge, and nothing collides. Its flaws: the NEW badge is tiny and floats under the headline instead of sitting near the CTA, the bottle is very small, and the Try It button is cramped against the right edge.
